text:
Coming this way?
I’d advise against it.\c
Any Trainer with a Wishing Star is in for a beating
from me and my Pokémon![VAR 0114(0042)]
You.\c\nYou’re the Gym Challenger endorsed by\nthe Champion, aren’t you?[VAR 0114(0042)]

What a joke.\c
You are aware that the chairman is more
important than the Champion, right?\c
I was chosen by the chairman himself, so that
makes me more amazing than you![VAR 0114(0042)]
I suppose I should prove beyond doubt just how\npathetic you are and how strong I am.[VAR 0114(0042)]
Well, that was unexpected.\nI suppose you’re more able than I thought.[VAR 0114(000C)]

Naturally, I’ll remember your battle style and
strategies now.\c
I’m sure to easily defeat you if and when
we face each other in an official match.[VAR 0114(000C)]

Now that we’ve established that, I won’t waste
any more time on you.\c
I’ve already gathered every Wishing Star in
this area.
